Name: Monteso's Bonsai Trees
Author: monteso
Description:
WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE


Just a quick little mod I made while bored. This replaces 5 of the house plotted plants with 5 different shape bonsai trees. You still need to find and purchase the items ingame.

Check out [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1399/?]Custom Furniture - Bonsai Treesby [b]Xangria[/b][/url]for a standalone version using the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254/?]Custom Furniture by [b]Platonymous[/b]
[/url]
[u][b]Install info[/b][/u]
Extract the furniture.xnb form the zip file. Place it in your Stardew Valley/Content/Tilesheets folder and replace.
